item.description:
Thimble 0.5.0 shows projects as boards, splits Work from Life, and turns the Dashboard into cards.
- A project can show as a list or a board, with a column per heading. Drag tasks between columns. View > as List (⌥⌘1) or as Board (⌥⌘2), chosen per project and synced. - An area can be Work or Life. Work areas get their own group in the sidebar, and Today, Upcoming, and Anytime gain an All, Work, Life bar. - The Dashboard is now a grid of cards. Each count (needs you, buildable, blocked, stalled) opens its project showing only those tasks, and each project has a status strip on top with the same counts. - Settings > Look > Open on picks where Thimble opens: the last page or the Dashboard. - Settings > Sync > Move to a Bucket moves a folder's sync to a bucket, keeping a safety copy first. - A bucket is checked every 30 seconds while Thimble is open, so changes from other devices arrive sooner.
